incoming.name: Llywelyn the Great
incoming.excerpt: Llywelyn took the opportunity to annex southern Powys and northern Ceredigion and rebuild Aberystwyth castle.

outgoing.name: Edward I of England
outgoing.excerpt: Edward I rebuilt Strongbow's Castle in 1277, after its destruction by the Welsh.

outgoing.name: Elizabeth I of England
outgoing.excerpt: It is thus styled in a charter granted by Henry VIII, but by Elizabeth I's time the town was invariably termed Aberystwyth in all documents.
